text: Basal and squamous cell carcinomas of the skin of the vulva are coded to C519 and are reportable; basal and squamous carcinomas of the skin of the perineum would be coded to C445 and would not be reportable.

Isolated tumor cells (ITCs) are defined as single tumor cells or small clusters not greater than 0.2 mm, usually detected by immunohistochemical (IHC) or molecular methods. ITCs do not usually show evidence of malignant activity (e.g., proliferation or stromal reaction).
Lymph nodes with ITCs only are not counted as positive nodes for Summary Stage

codes.1: Localized only (localized, NOS): Invasive carcinoma WITH or WITHOUT stromal invasion confined to musculature, submucosa, or vulva including skin. FIGO Stage I (IA, IB, I NOS)
codes.2: Regional by direct extension only: Adjacent perineal structures; anus; bladder wall or bladder, NOS excluding mucosa; perianal skin; rectal wall or rectum, NOS excluding mucosa; urethra, NOS, including lower/distal third of urethra; vagina, NOS; vulva and perineum involved WITH or WITHOUT stromal invasion. FIGO Stage II
codes.3: Regional lymph node(s) involved only: Femoral; inguinal, NOS, including inguinofemoral (groin), Node of Cloquet or Rosenmuller (highest deep inguinal), and superficial inguinal; regional lymph node(s), NOS, including lymph node(s), NOS; localized tumor WITH regional lymph node involvement. FIGO Stage III (IIIA, IIIB, IIIC, III NOS), IVA
codes.4: Regional by BOTH direct extension AND regional lymph node(s) involved: Codes (2) + (3)
codes.7: Distant site(s)/lymph node(s) involved: Distant site(s) (including further contiguous extension), including bladder mucosa, fixed to pubic bone (pelvic bone), perineal body, rectal mucosa, and urethra: upper/proximal two-thirds; distant lymph node(s), NOS, including pelvic, NOS; iliac, NOS; common; external; internal (hypogastric) (obturator); paracervical; parametrial; sacral, NOS; lateral (laterosacral); middle (promontorial) (Gerota's node); presacral; and uterosacral; distant metastasis, NOS, including carcinomatosis and distant metastasis WITH or WITHOUT distant lymph node(s). FIGO Stage IVA; NONE or UNKNOWN regional lymph node involvement. FIGO Stage IVB, IV NOS
